name: FEA GUI: wire createFeaModeStore() into production component tree (DualViewport.tsx)

task_definition.title: FEA GUI: wire createFeaModeStore() into production component tree (DualViewport.tsx)
task_definition.description: Task 2962 shipped FeaModeToolbar.tsx, scalarRange.ts, and conditional Viewport.tsx effects all gated on `props.feaModeStore`, but never called `createFeaModeStore()` in any production call site. DualViewport.tsx passes feaDiagnostics to <Viewport> (line 232) but has zero reference to feaModeStore or createFeaModeStore. App.tsx likewise has zero references. All B5/B6 PRD signals (contour renders, deformed shape via warp slider) are permanently dead code in the running app because `props.feaModeStore === undefined` gates all contour/deformed rendering. This blocks task 2968 (FEA visual regression baselines).
